info.name: Lunara — Party Plans API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Party Plans feature of the Lunara platform.

## Base URLs
- **Local Dev:** `http://localhost:9076`
- **Production:** `http://103.224.247.35:9076`

## Authentication
All Party Plan endpoints are **public** — no Bearer token needed.
Passing `userId` in the request body is used to identify the creator.

## Key Endpoints
| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/mobile/party-plans` | ✅ Create a party plan (on tap of POST PARTY PLAN) |
| `GET` | `/api/mobile/party-plans` | Get all active plans |
| `GET` | `/api/mobile/party-plans/user/:userId` | Get all plans by a user |
| `GET` | `/api/mobile/party-plans/:id` | Get single plan with full details |
| `PATCH` | `/api/mobile/party-plans/:id/status` | Update plan status |
| `DELETE` | `/api/mobile/party-plans/:id` | Delete a plan |

item.name: 1. Create Party Plan (POST PARTY PLAN button)

exec: console.log('✅ Party Plan ID saved:', res.data.id);

request.description:
## POST PARTY PLAN

This is the main endpoint called when the user taps the **POST PARTY PLAN** button in the Create a Party Plan screen.

### Required Fields
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | UUID string | ID of the logged-in user (plan creator) |
| `venueId` | UUID string | ID of the selected venue |
| `message` | string | Party message / description (1–500 chars) |
| `planDateTime` | ISO 8601 string | Date and time of the party (must be future) |

### Example Success Response (201)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Party plan posted successfully! 🎉",
  "data": {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "status": "active",
    "message": "Let's party at H2O! 🚀",
    "planDateTime": "2025-12-31T22:00:00.000Z",
    "createdAt": "2025-05-14T07:00:00.000Z",
    "user": { "id": "...", "firstName": "Vishal", "lastName": "K", "email": "..." },
    "venue": { "id": "...", "name": "H2O", "city": "Mumbai", "category": "club" }
  }
}
```

### Validation Errors (400)
- `userId` is required and must be a UUID
- `venueId` is required and must be a UUID
- `message` is required (max 500 chars)
- `planDateTime` must be a valid future ISO 8601 date

Returns all party plans with full user and venue details.

Each plan in the response includes:
- `id`, `status`, `message`, `planDateTime`, `createdAt`
- `user` — creator details (name, email, bio, occupation, city, gender)
- `venue` — venue details (name, address, category, cover charge)

item.name: 3. Get All Plans by User ID

request.description:
Returns all party plans posted by a specific user.

Use this for:
- Showing the user's own plans in their profile
- Displaying plans history

item.name: 4. Get Single Party Plan by ID

request.description: Returns complete details of a single party plan including full user and venue details.

Update the status of a party plan.

Valid statuses:
- `active` — plan is visible and live
- `inactive` — plan is hidden but not deleted
- `cancelled` — plan is cancelled

**Only the plan creator** (matching `userId`) can update the status.

Permanently deletes a party plan.

**Only the plan creator** (matching `userId`) can delete the plan.

Returns 403 if userId doesn't match the creator.

Filter all active party plans at a specific venue.
Useful for showing plans at the currently viewed venue.
